#include <MsgBoxConstants.au3>
#cs
Block comment
#ce
Local $sName = "world", $iCount = 3
Func Greet($sWho, $iTimes = 1)
    For $i = 1 To $iTimes
        ConsoleWrite("Hello, " & $sWho & "! ""quoted""" & @CRLF)
    Next
    Return StringLen($sWho)
EndFunc
If $iCount > 0 And Not False Then MsgBox($MB_OK, "Title", Greet($sName, 2))
